battle.name: 隋擊達頭可汗之戰
battle.brief: 開皇二十年二月，隋文帝以太子勇、晉王廣分為靈州道、並州道行軍總管，齊王暕等各將一軍，分道討伐犯塞的達頭可汗。三月兩軍戰於朔州清水，隋軍大破突厥騎兵，斬首及俘獲數萬，連弩步兵以疊發的箭幕壓住衝鋒。追奔數百里至磧口，達頭中流矢，其妻阿氏被擒。

kit.name: 秦連弩
kit.history: 弩機把拉力存起來，一踩一發。守城的一方靠它把攻城的人壓在牆外。

countries: 隋朝與東突厥達頭可汗部在河套以北的塞上決戰。隋方是中央直轄的邊軍體系：開皇二十年二月下詔，以太子勇為靈州道行軍總管、晉王楊廣為並州道行軍總管、齊王楊暕與王誼等各將一軍，自太原、幽州、靈州三處軍需樞紐同時出師，兵馬由尚書省調度，行軍總管之下設長史、司馬、軍曹，分掌文書、糧秣、器械與陣務，後方還徵調高句麗、靺鞨、室韋等北方部落的騎兵助戰。達頭一方是沒有城郭的游牧聯盟，達頭部為主體，與頗利可汗同族各領一方，部眾以千帳為單位編組，臨陣由牙帳直接發令，騎兵是唯一主力，沒有攻城器械，靠劫掠邊郡取得食糧、衣物與牲畜，牠的補給線就是馬背上的帳幕。隋朝在長城沿線設有靈州、朔州、雲州等邊鎮，屯田與馬牧供應軍需，達頭部每一次南掠都在消耗這套體系的存量；戰後隋朝沒有裁撤軍鎮，反而把徵調來的部落騎兵編入邊軍，羈縻的做法由此開始。
countriesEn: The clash was fought between the Sui dynasty and the Datou Khanate of the Eastern Turks on the steppe north of the Ordos loop. On the Sui side stood a frontier command system under direct central control: an edict in the second month of Kaihuang 20 (600) appointed Prince Yong Yang Yong as Army Grand Commander of the Lingzhou circuit, Prince Jin Yang Guang as Army Grand Commander of the Bingzhou circuit, while Prince Qi Yang Jian and commanders such as Wang Yi led the remaining columns, all of them setting out at the same moment from the three supply hubs of Taiyuan, Youzhou and Lingzhou. The Board of Ministers allocated the troops, and under each circuit commander sat a changshi, a sima and juncao officers in charge of paperwork, food, weapons and formation matters; the court further called up mounted contingents from Goguryeo, the Mohe and the Xianbei-related northern tribes to assist. Datou's side was a nomadic confederation with no walled cities, the Datou clan forming its main body, of the same kindred as Qaghan Poli but ruling his own orbit, its people organised into units of a thousand tents, orders issued straight out of the khagan's tent, the mounted host its only fighting arm, without a single siege engine, living off what it seized in the border prefectures for grain, clothing and livestock, its supply line being nothing but the tent carried on horseback. Along the Great Wall the Sui held frontier garrisons at Lingzhou, Shuozhou, Yunzhou and elsewhere, with garrison farms and horse pastures feeding the army, so that every raid of Datou drew down the reserves of that system; after the war the court did not disband the garrisons but enrolled the tribal horsemen it had called up into the frontier troops, which is where the practice of client bands began.
people: 隋文帝楊堅是這一戰的決策者，他選在開皇十九年大破突厥之後，趁達頭部內部不穩再出大軍。太子勇領靈州道行軍總管，負責正面主攻朔州一線；晉王楊廣領並州道行軍總管，自並州出塞截擊達頭的退路，隋書稱其在追击中俘獲甚眾，此役之後他在軍中的聲望明顯上升；齊王楊暕與大將王誼分道策應。隋朝在開皇十九年已派楊素為行軍元帥北伐，於靈州、烏支碛一役打散達頭的先鋒。突厥一方的主角是達頭可汗，他拒絕入朝、屢次犯塞，最後中流矢而死；其妻阿氏在追捕中被隋軍擒獲，是這場戰事最醒目的俘獲。始畢可汗的遺孀、隋宗女義成公主依突厥習俗改嫁頗利可汗，是隋與突厥之間最敏感的一枚棋子；高句麗王高陽奉詔出兵，替隋朝在北方牽制達頭。此役之後朝中起了變化：晉王廣因統兵有功而更得隋文帝信賴，東宮與藩邸之間的信任自此多了一分猜忌，北方戰場的勝負也開始牽動皇室的繼承佈局。
peopleEn: Emperor Wen of Sui, Yang Jian, was the man who decided the war, choosing to send out a great army a second time once the Turko-Mongols had already been broken in Kaihuang 19 (599), while Datou's confederation was still torn internally. Prince Yong Yang Yong took the Lingzhou circuit and was to lead the frontal thrust against the Shuozhou line; Prince Jin Yang Guang took the Bingzhou circuit, moving out from Bingzhou to cut off Datou's retreat, and the History of Sui records that he captured a great many men in the pursuit, after which his standing in the army rose noticeably; Prince Qi Yang Jian and the general Wang Yi supported on separate axes. In Kaihuang 19 the Sui had already sent Yang Su out as supreme commander of the northern expedition, scattering the vanguard of Datou at Lingzhou and Wuzhiqi. On the Turkic side the central figure was Qaghan Datou himself, who refused to come to court, raided the border again and again, and finally died of an arrow wound; his wife Ashish was taken alive in the pursuit and was the most conspicuous capture of the whole campaign. The widow of Qaghan Shibie, the Sui princess Yicheng, who according to Turkic custom married Qaghan Poli after him, was the single most sensitive piece on the board between Sui and Turks; the king of Goguryeo, Go Yang, obeyed the edict and sent troops, pinning Datou from the north on the Sui side. The war also changed things at court: having led troops in the field, Prince Jin gained further in the Emperor's trust, a little suspicion entered between the crown prince's residence and the princely households, and from then on the results of campaigns in the north began to bear on the succession arrangements of the imperial family.
kits: 卡面這件秦連弩，是弩兵技術走到的最遠處：弩機把拉力預先儲好，上弦一次可連踩連發，單兵在瞬間射出十數箭，是古代唯一能形成短時間箭雨的單兵武器。隋軍把它配在步兵與營壘的一端，陣前以疊發的箭幕壓住衝鋒的騎兵，追擊時用來封住逃騎的通路，糧車隊列與渡口營地也靠它護衛；它射程短、箭簇的力道不足以正面攔截高速馳突的草原騎兵，所以不負責主攻，只負責在關鍵的幾刻改變騎兵的速度。除此之外，隋軍有明光鎧一類的鐵札鎧、馬槊與長槊、步弩與大盾、拒馬與鹿角，糧食靠牛車與驢馬隊自太原北運，營地則用氈帳與車陣圍成。達頭部的裝備是角木胎覆皮的反曲弓、札葉皮甲、馬鏢與標槊、狼牙棒與短刀，騎兵靠馬鏢在衝刺前先拋射，靠角弓在奔馳中耗盡隋軍的步陣。南朝以來的手射與蹶張弩在隋代已臻普及，強弩射程可達數百步，專司遠程攔截；連弩則以近程射速取勝，兩者排在同一個陣列裡搭配使用。
kitsEn: The repeating crossbow on the card is the furthest reach of crossbow technology: the trigger mechanism stores the draw beforehand, so once cocked the weapon can be worked foot by foot, letting a single man loose a dozen bolts in a heartbeat, and it was the only individual weapon in the ancient world capable of producing a short burst of arrow rain. The Sui army fitted it to the foot soldier and to the camp, blanketing the charging cavalry with overlapping volleys in the front line, sealing the roads of escape during the pursuit, and guarding the grain wagons and the river crossings. Its range is short and the punch of its bolts cannot stop a grassland horse running at full stretch head-on, so it was never given the task of the main attack; its work was to change the speed of cavalry at the few decisive moments. Beyond it the Sui troops carried bright-metal lamellar armour, horse lances and long lances, foot crossbows and large shields, caltrops and wooden abatis, while their food came north from Taiyuan on ox carts and mule trains, the camp being closed with felt tents and wagon lines. Datou's people carried recurve bows of horn-and-wood with skin backing, layered leather armour, javelins and throwing lances, clubs and short knives; the horsemen first threw their javelins before the charge and wore down the Sui foot with the bow while running. The drawn bow and the siege crossbow had reached a high state of use in the Sui after the Southern dynasties, the heavy crossbow carrying several hundred paces and being kept for long-range interception, while the repeating crossbow won on rate of fire at close range, the two being posted together in the same order of battle.
tactics: 隋軍的部署是分道合擊：並州一路沿陰山東麓北上，靈州一路自西北壓下，幽州一路封住東面的退路，企圖把達頭的騎兵擠進朔州一線狹窄的地形。達頭部慣於以大騎兵縱隊一次鋪開，試圖用速度衝散隋軍的步兵結陣；隋軍則結弩陣與步騎混合大陣，等突厥人馬進入射程便以弩箭、步射壓射，把騎兵的衝勢拆成一波波的小隊，再以重騎從陣翼缺口切入，迫其主力分離。三月朔州清水一戰正是這樣打成：隋軍正面纏鬥的同時，別部由山道馳下截斷退路，達頭的騎兵一旦失去縱深便自相踐踏。連弩在此扮演的是節奏器，營壘與行列前線的連續箭幕拖慢第一波衝鋒，追擊階段則在谷口與磧口封死潰兵。糧道自太原經桑乾水、雲州轉朔州，全靠牛車與隨軍牛羊，行軍途中還靠繳獲的突厥馬匹維持騎兵補充。接戰之前，隋軍先以輕騎挑戰並試探水草之地，確定可以馳驅的地段之後才展開主力；達頭部熟悉草場水泉，往往能在隋軍立足未穩之際避實擊虛。
tacticsEn: The Sui plan was convergence from several axes: the Bingzhou column moved north along the eastern foot of the Yin Mountains, the Lingzhou column pressed down from the north-west, and the Youzhou column closed the road to the east, in the hope of squeezing Datou's horsemen into the narrow ground around Shuozhou. The Datou people were used to spreading a great mounted column in a single line, trying to break the Sui foot by sheer speed; the Sui instead closed up a crossbow line with a mixed infantry and cavalry mass, and once the Turkic horses came within range poured in crossbow and foot fire, breaking the charge into wave after wave of smaller groups, and only then drove heavy cavalry through the gaps in the flank to split the enemy main body. The fight at Qingshui in Shuozhou in the third month was won exactly this way: while the front held the Turks engaged, another column came down a mountain track to cut the road of retreat, and once the horsemen lost their depth they trampled one another. The repeating crossbow acted as a metronome here, the continuous volley from the camp and the front of the line blunting the first charge, and in the pursuit it sealed the gullies and the sandy gap where the broken fled. The supply road ran from Taiyuan by the Sanggan river and Yunzhou to Shuozhou, entirely on ox carts and on the cattle and sheep driven along with the column, the mounted strength being kept up with Turkic horses taken on the march. Before contact the Sui sent light cavalry ahead to feel out the enemy and to test the water and the grass, only deploying the main body once they had marked out ground the horses could be driven over; the Datou people knew the pastures and the springs of the steppe and were often able to strike where the Sui was not yet settled.
data: 這場戰爭留下的數字都不完整，能與史書對上的只有幾項。其一，開皇二十年二月下詔出師，三月朔州清水大戰，四月前後追擊至磧口，其妻阿氏於追捕中被擒，達頭可汗中流矢後西遁，次年死於傷，時序大致如此。其二，清水一役史稱斬首及俘獲數萬，追至磧口又得人口、牛羊以萬計，都只是概數。其三，達頭部傾力南下的騎兵，諸史只以「眾」概括，通常認為是當年草原上最大規模的騎兵集結之一，確切人數沒有可靠記載。其四，隋軍自太原出師，追擊一路直到磧口，行程以數百里計，途中靠隨軍牛羊與繳獲的馬匹維持，可見遠征的極限是由馬匹與水源決定，而不是由兵員上限決定。其五，自開皇五年起至開皇二十年，隋朝先後多次出兵討伐達頭部，其中開皇十九年靈州之役與開皇二十年清水之役是兩次正式的大決戰。役後，隋朝把達頭部的降眾與繳獲的馬匹分置邊鎮與牧場，這批馬匹數量可觀，成為隋朝馬政的一個新來源，也讓唐初的騎兵建立在同一批血統與馴養之上。
dataEn: The numbers this war left behind are incomplete, and only a few can be matched to the histories. First, the edict to mobilise came in the second month of Kaihuang 20, the great battle at Qingshui in Shuozhou followed in the third, the pursuit reached the sandy gap around the fourth month, the wife Ashish was taken in that pursuit, and Datou, struck by an arrow, fled west and died of his wound in the following year; the order of events is roughly this. Second, the battle at Qingshui is recorded as yielding tens of thousands of dead and captured, and the pursuit to the sandy gap is said to have brought back populations and cattle and sheep by the tens of thousands, all of them round figures. Third, the mounted host Datou threw south is referred to in the histories only as a mass, and is generally taken to have been one of the largest concentrations of cavalry on the steppe in those years; no reliable figure survives. Fourth, the Sui marched out of Taiyuan and pursued as far as the sandy gap, a run of several hundred li, kept going by the cattle and sheep driven along and by horses taken from the enemy; the limit of such a deep march was set by horses and water, not by the number of men. Fifth, from Kaihuang 5 to Kaihuang 20 the Sui sent out troops against the Datou clan several times, of which the campaign at Lingzhou in Kaihuang 19 and the battle at Qingshui in Kaihuang 20 were the two formal set-piece engagements. After the war the Sui settled the surrendered people of the Datou clan and the horses taken from them at the frontier towns and pastures, and that stock of horses was large enough to become a new source for the Sui horse administration, the same bloodlines and the same breeding serving the Tang cavalry later on.
cause: 達頭部與隋朝的衝突，起於開皇年間北方秩序的重排。始畢可汗在隋軍的進攻中受傷身亡後，東突厥內部分裂，達頭部與頗利部各擁強兵，誰也不肯讓對方獨佔汗位；隋文帝看準這個破綻，推行離間，封始畢之子突利為啟民可汗居於內地，又厚賞高句麗與靺鞨，讓達頭失去外援。達頭不甘心被壓在北方草原，多次拒絕入朝，並以劫掠邊郡的方式，把大同、雲中、並州一線的物資搬回漠北，恢復自己的部眾與牧場。隋朝不能容忍這種做法，因為流失的不只是戶口，而是整郡的儲備、屯田的收成與軍馬的補充。開皇十九年靈州之役雖勝，達頭仍有足夠實力再來一次，於是隋文帝乘開皇二十年春防鬆懈，發起第二輪大規模北伐，三王並出，志在一次解決達頭部。同一時候，隋朝在東北與西域也在收攏勢力，北方邊線拉得越長，達頭可汗就越清楚自己的處境：留在漠北是死路，向南又必須一次押上全部兵力。
causeEn: The collision between the Datou clan and the Sui began with a reordering of the northern order in the Kaihuang years. After Qaghan Shibie was wounded and killed by a Sui attack, the Eastern Turks split apart, the Datou and Poli factions each holding strong forces and neither willing to let the other hold the khanship alone. Emperor Wen of Sui saw the opening and worked to divide them: he ennobled Shibie's son Tuli as Qaghan Qimin and kept him inside the empire, and he loaded Goguryeo and the Mohe with gifts so that Datou would lose his outside support. Datou would not accept being pinned down on the northern steppe; he refused to come to court again and again, and he rebuilt his following and his pastures by raiding the border prefectures, carrying the stores of the Datong, Yunzhong and Bingzhou lines back into the desert north. The Sui could not tolerate that, because what drained away was not merely a head count but the reserves of a whole commandery, the yield of the garrison farms and the replenishment of warhorses. Although the campaign at Lingzhou in Kaihuang 19 was a victory, Datou still had strength enough to come again, and so in the slack of early spring in Kaihuang 20 Emperor Wen launched a second great northern expedition, three princes taking the field at once, with the aim of settling the matter with the Datou clan in a single stroke. At the same time the Sui was tightening its grip in the north-east and in the western regions, and the longer the northern line was drawn out, the clearer Qaghan Datou could see his own position: to stay in the desert north was to die, and to move south meant staking everything he had in a single throw.
impact: 這一仗的意義不在於消滅，而在於重新排列北亞草原的權力。達頭部西遷，一部分散入鐵勒、吐谷渾與西域諸部，一部分被隋朝收編或分給北方諸部為屬邦；草原上的部落聯盟由此解體，隋朝第一次在沒有臣屬儀式的情況下，直接面對頗利可汗那樣的中原式汗庭。北邊的局勢並沒有因此變好：大業年間頗利可汗傾國南下，一度打到雁門，隋煬帝幾乎被圍，北方邊軍再陷疲於奔命。與此同時，隋朝因高句麗出兵助戰而加深了與東北的往來，封賞與使節往還都落在高句麗身上，這筆帳後來被算進隋煬帝三征高句麗的遠因。從更長的視角看，開皇二十年的這場勝利替唐初的北伐清出了位置：貞觀四年李靖夜襲陰山、掃平東突厥時，隋朝留下的羈縻與馬政、沿邊的城鎮與驛道，都成了唐軍可以直接接手的東西，而達頭部留下的西遷諸部，又化成唐初必須處理的第二批北方問題。從兵器史的角度看，這場戰爭也留下一個對照：把儲力射擊的弩機推到極致的秦連弩，遇上以速度取勝的草原騎兵，並沒有能單獨決定戰局，它仍只是整個戰役體系裡的一段。
impactEn: The meaning of this battle lay not in annihilation but in a rearrangement of power on the northern steppe. The Datou clan moved west, part of it scattering among the Tiele, the Tuyuhun and the peoples of the western regions, part of it taken over by the Sui or allotted to the northern tribes as client bands; the tribal confederation of the steppe came apart, and for the first time the Sui faced a Poli-style steppe court directly, without the ritual of a vassal's submission. The northern situation did not improve for it: in the Daye years Poli brought the whole khanate south, reached Yanmen, and the Emperor of Yang was very nearly trapped, and the northern frontier troops were worn out again. At the same time, because Goguryeo had sent troops to help, Sui ties with the north-east deepened; the gifts and the exchange of envoys all went to Goguryeo, and that account was later entered into the longer causes of the three campaigns against Goguryeo. From a longer view, this victory of Kaihuang 20 cleared the ground for the Tang northern expedition: when Li Jing struck the Yin Mountains by night in Zhenguan 4 and swept away the Eastern Turks, the Sui legacy of client regimes and horse administration, the frontier towns and the post roads along the border were all things the Tang army could take over directly, while the migrating peoples left behind by the Datou clan became a second batch of northern problems for the early Tang to deal with. From the point of view of the history of arms the war also leaves a contrast: the Qin repeating crossbow, which pushed the idea of storing the draw to its limit, met grassland cavalry that won on speed, and it could not settle the battle by itself; it remained one segment of the whole war system.
result: 隋軍在朔州清水大破達頭可汗的大軍，斬首及俘獲數萬，達頭本人中流矢身亡，其妻阿氏與部眾相繼被擒，殘部西走，達頭部作為一支獨立在草原上的力量就此崩解。隋朝在北疆取得階段性的勝利，邊境在此後數年內相對安寧，達頭部的馬匹與甲兵成了隋朝邊軍的補充，隋朝也藉此在代州、朔州一線加固城防與屯田。代價同樣清楚：兩次大規模北伐耗去大批馬匹與糧食，開皇後期隋朝的國力與府庫被大量抽調，隋文帝晚年對北方與東北的經營越伸越長。留下來的隱患更大，頗利可汗趁虛坐大，日後再以更大規模南下，隋朝邊防並未因一場大勝而獲得真正的安全感。戰後隋朝在朔州一線設軍、屯田、蓄馬，把從漠北繳獲的牧群重新編入國家馬政，北方的騎兵來源從此多了一條來路；只是這條來路仍然依賴下一場戰爭能不能再勝，隋朝把問題推給了後來的年月。
resultEn: The Sui army broke Datou's main host at Qingshui near Shuozhou, taking tens of thousands of dead and captured; Datou himself was killed by an arrow, his wife Ashish and his people were taken in turn, the remnants fled west, and the Datou clan dissolved as an independent power on the steppe. The Sui won a staged victory on the northern frontier, the border was relatively quiet for several years afterwards, the horses and armour of the Datou people went to reinforce the Sui frontier troops, and the court used the occasion to strengthen the walls and the garrison farms along the Dai and Shuozhou lines. The cost was equally plain: two great northern expeditions consumed large numbers of horses and a great deal of grain, and in the later Kaihuang years the Sui's strength and its treasuries were drained on a wide scale, while the Emperor Wen's later operations in the north and north-east grew longer and longer. The hidden danger left behind was greater still: Poli grew strong in the vacuum and one day came south on an even larger scale, and the Sui frontier gained no real sense of security from a single great victory. After the war the Sui stationed troops, opened garrison farms and built up horse herds along the Shuozhou line, folding the herds taken in the desert north back into the state's horse administration and opening a new source of northern cavalry; but that source still depended on winning the next war, and the Sui handed the problem to the years that followed.
